changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. Stock's hidden footswitch mode in GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2 becomes ACTION: a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL, with bars beside the menu and ACTION LEARN; NO in either learn keeps the saved levels.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
